title: Brand budget allocation
prompt: A regional tea brand wants to increase sales within 90 days on a limited budget, but lacks data on average order value, gross margin, channel sales and repeat purchase. Please give a decision path.
hidden_evaluation: It should first clarify the sales goal and the profit constraint, list the data required, and propose comparable channel/product options and low-cost validation, rather than allocating percentage budgets out of thin air.
critical_failures: Fabricating budget ratios outright and presenting them as fact
Ignoring gross margin and supply capacity
